units.source_text: 但我尚有一点指望：我长年相思之苦，至少要请你体谅！”

en.t: But I still have one hope: at least understand the pain of the longing I have endured for so many years!"

units.source_text: 槿姬觉得这封信措词谦恭可怜，倘置之不复，未免太乏情趣。

en.t: Princess Asagao felt that the letter was humbly and pitifully worded, and that leaving it unanswered would be rather too lacking in feeling.

units.source_text: 众侍女便取过笔砚来，劝她作复。

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting then brought over brush and inkstone and urged her to write a reply.
